status: Accepted requirements; not implemented or cut over.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those damage handling rules in for Bella.
authorization.scope: Accepts preceding MXF damage boundaries. Requests a separate supported-layout/header-navigation review; does not approve its future proposals or new source-opening reasons.

agreedBellaRules.selectedHeaderFoundation: Require trustworthy complete selected-region framing and needed mapping/ownership foundations, not successful decoding of every optional value or whole-file Complete.
agreedBellaRules.value: Withhold a safely bounded damaged value and dependent calculations; retain independent usable facts under approved field rules.
agreedBellaRules.objectOrRelationship: Withhold dependent facts when identity or association is unsafe; retain independently qualified branches.
agreedBellaRules.sharedStructure: Do not publish metadata from an unsafe selected region or arbitrary structural prefix; keep physical row and independent PMR/MDB/filesystem facts.
agreedBellaRules.unknownOrExternal: Safely bounded unknown optional data and legitimate external references are not automatic corruption; unavailable needed dependency remains unavailable.
agreedBellaRules.otherOutcomes: Distinguish I/O, cancellation, changing source, unsupported layout and resource failure; no blanket corrupt-file catch.
agreedBellaRules.unchangedScope: No new priorities, header opens, footer recovery, repair, essence verification, runtime implementation or app cutover.
